## Checks

## Accessibility

Complete each item that applies. For the others, write "not applicable" and why.

- [ ] Output is readable without colour: every status still has a word (`ok`, `WARN`, `FAIL`).
- [ ] Output still reads as plain text in a narrow terminal, and no words are cut off.
- [ ] Documentation keeps a logical heading order, gives every table a header in each column, and uses link text that names its target.
- [ ] New or changed commands work from the keyboard alone and do not wait for input unless their usage text says so.
- [ ] A new dependency is described here: what it does for keyboard and screen reader use (see Dependencies in ACCESSIBILITY.md).
- [ ] If the change alters what the tool prints, I read the new output in a screen reader, or I say that I did not.
